description: oemof.thermal supplies thermal-component models and preprocessing and postprocessing tools for heat pumps, concentrating solar power, thermal storage and solar collectors. The project explicitly describes active development. The provider is oemof developers. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README includes MIT terms. External data, solvers and dependencies have separate conditions. Limitations: Most functions are intended to work with oemof.solph, although some can be used independently. Model fidelity and suitability depend on the selected component. For simulation it supports thermal-energy model construction alongside energy-system optimisation. Related resources: This is a named extension of model-oemof-solph. The existing solph record does not explicitly include oemof.thermal.
